QuestInfo.name: About Great Fortitude
QuestInfo.0: Cassadra wants to fill you in about Great Fortitude.
QuestInfo.1: Fill the gauge by keeping the Training Stone in your Set-Up Inventory and battling monsters in specific areas. When the gauge is full, activate Great Fortitude to complete the quest. Click the Event Notifier and select <Great Fortitude Field Info> to check where you can charge your gauge.

QuestInfo.demandSummary: Activate the Great Fortitude skill once

0.0: You still have the Training Stone I gave you, right? I've already explained how to use it once, but I can go through it again if you want. Interested?

yes.0: Keep the Training Stone in your Set-Up Inventory, and hunt monsters in certain areas to fill up its gauge. Once it's full, you can activate your Great Fortitude skill, to bust up monsters even faster! Click the Event Notifier and select <Training Field Info> to check where you can charge your gauge. Please check these locations first, so you don't waste any training. All you have to do to complete the quest is use Great Fortitude, so give it a try!

no.0: Well, if you say you don't need any help, I trust you. Good luck out there!

default.0: I know you haven't used the Going Green skill yet. Don't try to trick me!
